guide.title: Lead Management Guide
guide.brief: Leads are the sales funnel entry, multi-channel input then converted to customers. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Lead Sources
steps.desc: Supports form submission, Excel import, manual entry; auto-tags source channel.

steps.title: Assignment & Follow-up
steps.desc: Assigned to sales staff, enters follow-up status; log calls/visits/emails.

steps.title: Status Flow
steps.desc: Unassigned → Assigned → Following → Converted/Abandoned; auto-recycled if overdue.

steps.title: Convert to Customer
steps.desc: Qualified leads convert to customers, auto-carrying contact info and follow-up history.

steps.title: Pool Recycling
steps.desc: Overdue leads auto-recycle to the public pool; other sales can reclaim.

guide.title: Customer Pool Guide
guide.brief: The pool stores overdue or inactive customers for re-claiming or reassignment. Expand for rules.

steps.title: Recycling Rules
steps.desc: Customers with overdue follow-ups (default 30 days) or no deals auto-recycle to pool.

steps.title: Claim Mechanism
steps.desc: Sales staff can actively claim customers from the pool; claimed customers move to their roster.

steps.title: Assignment
steps.desc: Administrators can reassign pool customers to specific sales staff.

steps.title: Protection Period
steps.desc: Claimed customers have a protection period (default 15 days) during which they won't be recycled.

steps.title: Policy Config
steps.desc: Different recycle periods and protection lengths can be configured by customer tier.

guide.title: Opportunity Management Guide
guide.brief: Opportunities are the core of the sales pipeline, from lead conversion to deal close. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Create Opportunity
steps.desc: Converted from lead or created directly; link customer/contact, fill expected amount and win probability.

steps.title: Stage Progression
steps.desc: Initial contact → Need confirmation → Proposal/quote → Negotiation → Won/Lost, log follow-ups per stage.

steps.title: Linked Entities
steps.desc: Link customers, contacts, quotes, competitors to form a complete sales record.

steps.title: Deal Conversion
steps.desc: Won opportunities can generate contracts with auto-filled amount and customer info.

steps.title: Commission Linkage
steps.desc: Contract payment triggers commission rules; opportunity amount serves as commission base.

status.lockedTip: 🔒 Under approval process, info cannot be modified
status.rejectedDesc: Approval rejected, can be modified and resubmitted

paymentPlan.title: Payment Plan
paymentPlan.description: Add payment plan for smart due/overdue reminders
paymentPlan.howToAutoGenerateTip: System calculates receivables based on payment plans and reminds stakeholders before due dates. Supports triggers by signing, invoicing, settlement, or shipping.

paymentPlan.amountRequired: Row {n}: Planned amount must be greater than 0

select.opportunityPlaceholder: Click 'Select' button to pick an opportunity

guide.title: Contract Management Guide
guide.brief: Contracts formalize won deals, link to payment plans, and trigger commission. Expand for full flow.

steps.title: Create Contract
steps.desc: Created from won opportunity; link customer/opportunity, fill amount, sign date, payment method.

steps.title: Approval Flow
steps.desc: Submitted contracts go through multi-level approval; info is locked during approval.

steps.title: Status Flow
steps.desc: Draft → Pending → Approving → Executing → Completed; can be rejected for revision or terminated.

steps.title: Payment Plan
steps.desc: Attach payment plans after execution; due reminders by node, reconcile on payment registration.

steps.title: Commission Trigger
steps.desc: Payment completion auto-triggers commission rules, generating results for sales staff.
